summary: Initial audit: internet scans and failed Grafana traversal probes observed; no confirmed unauthorized access yet. Investigating server trust boundaries, scheduled jobs and restored logs; assessment is ongoing.

No confirmed unauthorized access in the restored logs or checks so far; observed Grafana traversal probes returned 404. Hardened the unauthenticated support endpoint, upload validation and execution, an unrestricted deploy sudo rule, a root job that executed writable PHP, a user-controlled export path, and CI maintenance/repository credential permissions. Site, release, database dump and payout checks remain healthy; monitoring continues.
